name: browserbase
description: Cloud browser automation via Browserbase and Stagehand: scrape pages, fill forms, extract structured data, and drive browsers with natural language — no local Chrome required.
long_description: Wraps the official @browserbasehq/mcp server for one-click install in Claude Desktop. Exposes 6 tools (start, end, navigate, act, observe, extract) backed by real cloud Chrome sessions. Bring your own Browserbase API key (free tier available) — no project ID needed, the key resolves it automatically.

tools.name: start
tools.description: Open (or reuse) a cloud browser session.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Load a URL in the current session.

tools.name: act
tools.description: Perform one interaction: click, type, select, scroll.

tools.name: observe
tools.description: List interactable elements matching a description.

tools.name: extract
tools.description: Pull structured data out of the current page.

browserbase_api_key.title: Browserbase API Key
browserbase_api_key.description: From browserbase.com/settings. No project ID needed.
